name: Open World
author: Claude - Oretsej
description: Free roam in a 32 km (20 mile) square of country generated from a fixed seed the way real country comes about: rivers and lakes, a market town, villages and farms where people would settle, a road network grown in order of importance, houses and high-street shops along the streets, glass towers in the town centre, a retail park and filling stations, village churches, sidewalks, parks with ponds, trails round the lakes, a race circuit with pits and grandstands, a gravel rally stage through the upland forest, a hill climb up a mountain valley to a col, farm tracks and footpaths that mostly run on to another road, road signs (a name sign at the way into every town and village, fingerposts where main roads meet and at country junctions, brown signs to the courses), garages at the filling stations, workshops, pits and course paddocks where the car can be refitted, repaired and refilled for the race and made the respawn point (marked on the map), farms, woods of the Forest's pines, grass and fields. Solo timed events at the circuit, the rally stage and the hill climb: stop in neutral in the start box beside the course (a chequered disc on the map) to be put on the grid, held there through the start lights, checkpoint gates to the finish, the time on the cockpit's board, a best time kept for each course. A wrecked car is put back at the start, or at a garage chosen in it for the rest of that race (in an event, at its last checkpoint), and driving goes on; no AI rivals. Built in the Tokyo scene. Day turns to night and back over a race (a day lasts 40 minutes), and storms drift across the country with the wind: rain in one valley and sun in the next, snow on the high ground, roads wet after a shower and drying; the same sky for everyone in a room. A floating origin keeps the physics precise anywhere. Works in Multiplayer rooms with the Multiplayer mod as it is.
